title: Accessing and Navigating the Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners

blocks.text: This article covers the following topics to help you get started with the Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal for partners:

blocks.item: Accessing the Multi-Tenant Portal

Zscaler Support configures a default admin role, which has access to all the functions in the Multi-Tenant Portal, and sends you an email requesting the password be reset for that role. After you reset that password, you can access the Multi-Tenant Portal.

For partners who have moved to Authentication Service, the login page redirects to the Authentication Service SSO screen after the Login ID screen. To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the Authentication Service Landing Page.
To access the Multi-Tenant Portal:
Enter your Login ID and Password.
Select Remember my Login ID if you want the Multi-Tenant Portal to remember your username the next time you log in.
From the drop-down menu, select the language in which you want to use the portal. By default, English (US) is selected.
Click Sign In.
Navigating within the Multi-Tenant Portal
The Multi-Tenant Portal has the following items in the left-side navigation:
Tenant

Click the Tenant icon to view all the tenants associated with your account. You can also create and manage tenant groups. To learn more, see About Tenants in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners and About Tenant Groups.
Roles
Click the Roles icon to view and manage admin roles for your account. To learn more, see About Roles in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Scopes
Click the Scopes icon to view and manage scopes for tenants and admins. To learn more, see About Scopes.
Admins
Click the Admins icon to view the admins configured for the Multi-Tenant Portal. To learn more, see About Admins in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Authentication Service

Click the Authentication Service icon to access the partner Authentication Service Admin Portal. This icon is only visible to users who have migrated to Authentication Service and possess the necessary permissions to access and manage the Multi-Tenant Portal within Authentication Service. To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the Authentication Service Admin Portal.
Policy Templates
Click the Policy Templates icon to view and manage policy templates for the tenants. To learn more, see About Policy Templates.
Audit Logs
Click the Audit Logs icon to view a list of actions performed in the Multi-Tenant Portal. To learn more, see About Audit Logs in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Settings
Click the Settings icon to view or modify your partner account settings. To learn more, see About Account Settings.
Account
Click the Account icon to see your account information, such as your partner account name and the admin user ID.
Sign Out
Click the Sign Out icon to sign out of the Multi-Tenant Portal when you are done. If you are inactive for 15 minutes, the Multi-Tenant Portal automatically logs you out.
Maintenance and Upgrade
You cannot access the Multi-Tenant Portal during an upgrade. A maintenance page is displayed during the active upgrade period.
